name: sui_leverage_loop
summary: Sui USDC lending leverage loop (Phase A.5). deposit → borrow → re-deposit → re-borrow until target_leverage OR max_iters OR health_factor breach. DRY-RUN by default; 3-gate live execute (dry_run=False AND MSPC_SWAP_LIVE=1 AND --confirm). Hard cap target_leverage<=5. Every iteration crystal-anchored tier='defi_loop' with model='sui_lending' + chain_context including step + cur_lev + hf — 'cc inference-chain --tier defi_loop' becomes the position history.

inputs.name: pool_id
inputs.notes: Sui lending pool object id (Navi or Scallop)

inputs.name: target_leverage
inputs.notes: Stop when cur_lev >= target. Hard cap 5.0 regardless

inputs.name: safety_ltv
inputs.notes: Halt loop when health_factor falls below

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.notes: Default true. Set false + MSPC_SWAP_LIVE=1 + --confirm to actually broadcast

passes.notes: Reject target_leverage > 5. Require --confirm flag past 2x. Validate env MSPC_SWAP_LIVE if dry_run=False.
sui client call → pool's max_ltv + asset price oracle + current utilization. Drives safe borrow_amt calculation.
Each iteration. DRY-RUN returns fake_digest_<iter>. Crystal anchor per step.
borrow_amt = collateral * ltv. Each iteration's borrow becomes next iteration's collateral.
HF = (collateral * price * liquidation_threshold) / borrow. HF < safety_ltv → halt with stop_reason='health_below_safety'.
OR-gate: cur_lev>=target | iter>=max | HF<safety. Returns stop_reason for audit.
tier='defi_loop', model='sui_lending'. Per-step records linked by correlation_id. coords=[total_deposited, total_borrowed, final_leverage, final_hf, step_count, was_dry_run_int].

depends_on: MSPC_SWAP_LIVE env (off by default; required to actually broadcast)
